ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)

   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.

   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)

   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

   B. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

13. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
